visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a grey t-shirt with a small lightning bolt logo stands in a bright outdoor walkway, surrounded by a group of four friends. He has an energetic facial expression with wide eyes and a large smile, gesturing with his hands as his friends clap and laugh behind him. The background features a clean building exterior with glass windows. (2) The scene shifts to the man standing in front of a FamilyMart convenience store with a clear green and blue logo above him. He points toward the store entrance with a confident stance. He is now wearing a grey t-shirt, and the lighting is bright natural daylight. (3) Inside the store, the man holds two glass bottles of EBEN brand Kombucha. One has a yellow label (Passion Mango) and the other a red label (Just Apple). He brings them close to the camera, showing his own face printed on the label. The store shelves are filled with various colorful bottled beverages in the background. (4) The man holds a smartphone showing a video call with another man (Eric) who is wearing a black cap and a white shirt. They both look happy and surprised. The setting is still inside the well-lit retail store. (5) A group of five young adults, including the main man, stand in the beverage aisle. They each hold a bottle of the Kombucha, clinking them together in a 'cheers' motion and then drinking with satisfied expressions. (6) The man returns to the front of the FamilyMart store, holding both bottles and smiling at the camera while gesturing broadly with his arms, concluding the presentation in the bright outdoor setting.
